main_text.head: CORRIGENDA.
main_text.p: Pag.162, ♆.16, fic diftingue, rudis eft forma. P.189. 31, spectantes. P.195, 12, lege, integer: nō quā Christus, &c. P.200, 24. pro ☞, leg. vt. P.250, 25, post corpus, adde, humanum. P.253. ♆. vlt. pro, conceptus, leg. consideratio. P.254, 4, cogna-tionem. P.258, 12, post ita, adde, alia. P.259, 27, τ' αὐτῷ. P.308, 8, vnam. P.321, 31, ponuntur. P. 343, 15, oppositarum. P.371, 6, affiɛta, ♆. vlt. egent. P.383, 8, leg. pertinereadt.

page.notes: The Greek phrase "τ' αὐτῷ" in the P.259 line is a reading of a small, partly blurred Greek fragment and is uncertain. The entry "pertinereadt" is printed as shown and may be a printing error for "pertinere ad". Several symbols (♆, ☞) are reproduced as best read from the scan; the errata abbreviations are doubtful.
